image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a small, young hamster (likely a dwarf variety) curled up in the palm of a human hand. The hamster has dense, soft-looking fur that is a mix of white, grey, and pale brownish-green tones. Its body is compact and rounded. One small ear is visible, along with part of its face tucked into its body. The background consists of the pinkish skin of the hand holding it and a blurry pink object in the upper right corner.
